instruction:
Task: Click one of your pieces on the board during your turn in gameplay.
Expected Result: The piece is selected, and all its valid moves (based on its current, possibly customized, move set) are visually indicated on the board.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
